purpose: Teach: 反撃/核心/燃える/揺れる/譲歩/一因/炎症/引き金

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 競合の反撃、強くなってきている。
lines.style: Even, measured delivery. State fact without alarm. Brief pause between clauses. Low, steady baseline. Authority speaking observation, not alarm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場戦略の核心、ブランド力です。
lines.en: Yes. The core of market strategy is brand strength.
lines.style: Focused, deliberate cadence. Acknowledge first, then present the insight clearly. Slight emphasis on 「核心」— this is the crux. Steady, attentive eye contact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界、燃える話題、続いてるな。
lines.en: There's been a steady stream of hot topics in the industry.
lines.style: Reflective observation. Slight weight on 「燃える」— the heat is real. Conversational, not lecturing. Settling into the chair slightly. Thoughtful pause underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。株価、揺れる時期、慎重に運用します。
lines.en: Yes. We're in a volatile period with the stock price—I'm managing it carefully.
lines.style: Assurance with underlying tension. The 「揺れる」carries the worry. Measured tempo, not rushed. Show competence through steadiness, not speed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 取引先に譲歩する姿勢、長期で得策だ。
lines.en: Showing flexibility with our partners—that's the right long-term move.
lines.style: Conviction on 「得策」. Not a suggestion, a conclusion. Lean forward slightly. Quiet authority. The warmth of approving a decision already made.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業績悪化の一因、海外要因、と分析しています。
lines.en: Yes. We've identified overseas factors as one of the causes behind the performance decline.
lines.style: Precise, structured. Present the analysis without defensiveness. Even-paced, professional. Show thoroughness without over-explaining.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 労使対立、炎症みたいに、長引かせるな。
lines.en: Don't let labor tensions fester like an infection—nip it early.
lines.style: Sharp metaphor delivered plainly. Brief, instructive. The comparison carries the weight. Low, firm baseline. This is a priority wrapped in a warning.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。トラブルの引き金、初動で抑えます。
lines.en: Yes. I'll contain any trouble at the source, right from the start.
lines.style: Commit clearly on 「抑えます」. Show readiness without bravado. Steady, confident. The assurance of someone who understands the weight of the instruction.
